# Options reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-docs.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

The formatter exposes **391 options** across 17 categories. Every one can be set in four places, listed here from lowest to highest precedence:

1. A **preset** (`"preset": "prettier"`), which supplies a whole coherent set at once.
2. A **configuration file** — `.auricformatrc`, `auric.format.json`, the `auricFormatter`
   key in `package.json`, or an existing `.prettierrc` (read for compatibility).
3. **`.editorconfig`**, for the handful of options it can express.
4. **VS Code settings** under `auricFormatter.*`, or a CLI flag, or an inline
   `// @auric printWidth=120` directive in the file itself.

Within a config file, `overrides[]` (matched by glob) and `languages{}` (matched by
language id) both beat the file's top-level values. Run **Auric Formatter: Explain
Formatting Decisions** to see exactly which layer set each option for the current file.

## Global

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `byteOrderMark` | `preserve` · `add` · `remove` | `"preserve"` | `--byte-order-mark <choice>` | Decide what happens to a UTF-8 byte order mark at the start of the file. |
| `cursorOffset` | int (-1–9007199254740991) | `-1` | `--cursor-offset <int>` | Track this character offset through the reformat and report where it lands. |
| `editorconfig` | boolean | `true` | `--no-editorconfig` | Read .editorconfig and translate indent_style, indent_size, end_of_line, max_line_length and the final-newline keys. |
| `embeddedLanguageFormatting` | `auto` · `off` | `"auto"` | `--embedded-language-formatting <choice>` | Decide whether code embedded inside another language is formatted. |
| `endOfLine` | `lf` · `crlf` · `cr` · `auto` · `preserve` | `"lf"` | `--end-of-line <choice>` | Choose the line ending written to disk. |
| `filepath` | path | `""` | `--filepath <path>` | Supply the path the text came from so language inference and glob overrides can work on stdin. |
| `formatEmbeddedUnknown` | boolean | `false` | `--format-embedded-unknown` | Attempt the universal engine on embedded fragments whose language has no native printer. |
| `insertFinalNewline` | boolean | `true` | `--no-insert-final-newline` | Guarantee the file ends with exactly one line ending. |
| `insertPragma` | boolean | `false` | `--insert-pragma` | Insert an @format pragma into the leading comment of files that were formatted. |
| `parser` | string | `""` | `--parser <string>` | Force a specific parser instead of inferring one from the file path or language id. |
| `plugins` | array | `[]` | `--plugins <array>` | List additional printer plugins to load, by module path or by registered plugin name. |
| `pragmaKeyword` | string | `"format"` | `--pragma-keyword <string>` | Set the bare word an opt-in pragma comment must contain, without the leading at sign. |
| `printWidth` | int (0–1000) | `80` <br>`120` for java, kotlin, scala, csharp, swift | `--print-width <int>` | Wrap lines that would otherwise exceed this many columns wherever the syntax allows a break. |
| `rangeEnd` | int (0–9007199254740991) | `9007199254740991` | `--range-end <int>` | Format only the text before this character offset. |
| `rangeStart` | int (0–9007199254740991) | `0` | `--range-start <int>` | Format only the text at or after this character offset. |
| `requirePragma` | boolean | `false` | `--require-pragma` | Format only files whose leading comment carries an @format or @auric-format pragma. |
| `respectIgnoreComments` | boolean | `true` | `--no-respect-ignore-comments` | Honour auric-ignore, auric-ignore-start and auric-ignore-end comments and leave those regions untouched. |
| `tabWidth` | int (0–24) | `2` <br>`4` for python, php, java, kotlin, csharp, c, cpp, objective-c, objective-cpp, rust, swift, groovy, solidity, apex<br>`4` for go, gomod, gowork, makefile, gotmpl | `--tab-width <int>` | Set how many columns one level of indentation occupies. |
| `tabWidthByLanguage` | array | `[]` | `--tab-width-by-language <array>` | Override `tabWidth` for individual languages with `languageId=width` entries such as `python=4`. |
| `trimTrailingWhitespace` | boolean | `true` | `--no-trim-trailing-whitespace` | Strip whitespace at the end of every line outside of strings and preserved blocks. |
| `useTabs` | boolean | `false` <br>`true` for go, gomod, gowork, makefile, gotmpl | `--use-tabs` | Indent with hard tab characters instead of spaces. |

## Common

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `arrowParens` | `always` · `avoid` | `"always"` | `--arrow-parens <choice>` | Choose whether a single arrow function parameter is parenthesised. |
| `bracketSameLine` | boolean | `false` | `--bracket-same-line` | Put the closing angle bracket of a multi-line opening tag on the last attribute line. |
| `bracketSpacing` | boolean | `true` | `--no-bracket-spacing` | Print spaces just inside object literal braces, as in `{ foo: 1 }`. |
| `curlyBraces` | `preserve` · `all` · `multi-line` | `"preserve"` | `--curly-braces <choice>` | Decide whether single-statement control-flow bodies get braces. |
| `hexCase` | `preserve` · `lower` · `upper` | `"lower"` | `--hex-case <choice>` | Choose the letter case of hexadecimal digits in numeric literals and colour values. |
| `htmlWhitespaceSensitivity` | `css` · `strict` · `ignore` | `"css"` | `--html-whitespace-sensitivity <choice>` | Choose how strictly whitespace around HTML elements is preserved. |
| `jsxSingleQuote` | boolean | `false` | `--jsx-single-quote` | Prefer single quotes over double quotes inside JSX attributes. |
| `objectWrap` | `preserve` · `collapse` | `"preserve"` | `--object-wrap <choice>` | Decide whether the author's first newline inside an object forces it to stay expanded. |
| `proseWrap` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--prose-wrap <choice>` | Choose how prose paragraphs are wrapped. |
| `quoteProps` | `as-needed` · `consistent` · `preserve` · `consistent-as-needed` | `"as-needed"` | `--quote-props <choice>` | Choose when object property keys are quoted. |
| `semi` | boolean | `true` | `--no-semi` | Print a semicolon at the end of every statement. |
| `singleAttributePerLine` | boolean | `false` | `--single-attribute-per-line` | Put every attribute on its own line as soon as a tag has to break. |
| `singleQuote` | boolean | `false` | `--single-quote` | Prefer single quotes over double quotes for strings. |
| `trailingComma` | `all` · `es5` · `none` | `"all"` | `--trailing-comma <choice>` | Choose where trailing commas are added in multi-line constructs. |
| `vueIndentScriptAndStyle` | boolean | `false` | `--vue-indent-script-and-style` | Indent the contents of the top-level <script> and <style> blocks in a single file component. |

| `elsePosition` | `same-line` · `new-line` | `"same-line"` | `--else-position <choice>` | Choose where the `else` keyword sits relative to the preceding closing brace. |

| `objectPropertyNewline` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--object-property-newline <choice>` | Choose whether every object property gets its own line. |
| `preserveArrayFormatting` | boolean | `false` | `--preserve-array-formatting` | Keep the author's line breaks in arrays of numbers and short literals so hand-laid tables survive. |
| `preserveObjectShape` | boolean | `true` | `--no-preserve-object-shape` | Keep an object expanded when the author already broke it after the opening brace. |

| `shortArrayThreshold` | int (0–100) | `0` | `--short-array-threshold <int>` | Collapse an array onto one line when it holds at most this many short elements, or 0 to decide by width alone. |

| `spaceBeforeBlocks` | boolean | `true` | `--no-space-before-blocks` | Print a space between a closing parenthesis or keyword and an opening block brace. |

| `switchCaseIndent` | boolean | `true` | `--no-switch-case-indent` | Indent `case` clauses one level inside the switch block. |
| `taggedTemplateFormat` | `auto` · `preserve` · `always` | `"auto"` | `--tagged-template-format <choice>` | Choose whether the contents of tagged template literals are formatted. |
| `templateExpressionSpacing` | boolean | `false` | `--template-expression-spacing` | Print spaces just inside template literal interpolations, as in `${ value }`. |
| `templateLiteralIndent` | `preserve` · `indent` · `dedent` | `"preserve"` | `--template-literal-indent <choice>` | Choose whether the interior of a template literal is re-indented. |
| `ternaryFormat` | `inline` · `indented` · `aligned` · `nested-flat` | `"indented"` | `--ternary-format <choice>` | Choose how conditional expressions are laid out when they break. |
| `yieldParens` | `as-needed` · `always` | `"as-needed"` | `--yield-parens <choice>` | Choose when the operand of `yield` is wrapped in parentheses. |

| `alignmentMaxPadding` | int (1–200) | `24` | `--alignment-max-padding <int>` | Abandon an alignment that would need more than this many spaces of padding on any line. |
| `alignmentMinGroupSize` | int (2–20) | `2` | `--alignment-min-group-size <int>` | Align a group only once it contains at least this many lines. |
| `alignmentUseSpacesOnly` | boolean | `true` | `--no-alignment-use-spaces-only` | Pad alignment with spaces even when the file is indented with tabs, so columns survive any tab width. |

## Sorting

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `classMemberOrder` | array | `["static-field","field","constructor","static-method","method","getter","setter"]` | `--class-member-order <array>` | List the class member kinds in the order they should be printed when class sorting is on. |
| `exportOrder` | `preserve` · `alphabetical` · `grouped` | `"preserve"` | `--export-order <choice>` | Choose the order of export declarations. |
| `importOrder` | array | `[]` | `--import-order <array>` | List regular expressions describing the import groups, in the order those groups should appear. |
| `importOrderCaseInsensitive` | boolean | `false` | `--import-order-case-insensitive` | Ignore letter case when sorting import paths. |
| `importOrderGroupNamespaceSpecifiers` | boolean | `false` | `--import-order-group-namespace-specifiers` | Put namespace imports at the top of their group. |
| `importOrderSeparation` | boolean | `false` | `--import-order-separation` | Separate the import groups with a blank line. |
| `importOrderSideEffectsFirst` | boolean | `true` | `--no-import-order-side-effects-first` | Keep side-effect-only imports at the top and never move them past another import. |
| `importOrderSortSpecifiers` | boolean | `false` | `--import-order-sort-specifiers` | Sort the named specifiers inside each import statement. |
| `importOrderTypeImports` | `preserve` · `first` · `last` · `separate` | `"preserve"` | `--import-order-type-imports <choice>` | Choose where type-only imports are sorted. |
| `sortCaseSensitivity` | `insensitive` · `sensitive` | `"insensitive"` | `--sort-case-sensitivity <choice>` | Choose how letter case is treated when sorting names. |
| `sortClassMembers` | boolean | `false` | `--sort-class-members` | Sort class members into the groups named by classMemberOrder. |
| `sortIgnorePrefix` | string | `""` | `--sort-ignore-prefix <string>` | Strip this leading prefix from a name before comparing it, so decorated names sort with their plain neighbours. |
| `sortImports` | boolean | `false` | `--sort-imports` | Sort import declarations into the groups named by importOrder. |
| `sortInterfaceMembers` | boolean | `false` | `--sort-interface-members` | Sort the members of an interface or object type alphabetically. |
| `sortNaturalNumeric` | boolean | `true` | `--no-sort-natural-numeric` | Compare digit runs inside names numerically so that item2 sorts before item10. |
| `sortObjectKeys` | boolean | `false` | `--sort-object-keys` | Sort the keys of object literals that carry a sort-keys comment directive. |
| `sortPreserveComments` | boolean | `true` | `--no-sort-preserve-comments` | Carry each entry's leading and trailing comments with it when it moves. |
| `sortRespectBlankLineGroups` | boolean | `true` | `--no-sort-respect-blank-line-groups` | Treat a blank line as a group boundary and sort only inside each group. |
| `sortUnionMembers` | boolean | `false` | `--sort-union-members` | Sort the members of a union type, keeping null and undefined last. |

## Comments

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bannerComment` | string | `""` | `--banner-comment <string>` | Ensure the file starts with this comment text, inserting it when it is missing. |
| `blankLineAfterComment` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-after-comment <choice>` | Choose whether standalone comment blocks are followed by a blank line. |
| `blankLineBeforeComment` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-before-comment <choice>` | Choose whether standalone comments are preceded by a blank line. |
| `blockCommentStarAlign` | boolean | `true` | `--no-block-comment-star-align` | Align the leading stars of a block comment one column in from the opening slash. |
| `blockCommentStarPad` | boolean | `false` | `--block-comment-star-pad` | Print a space after each leading star of a block comment. |
| `commentAttachment` | `smart` · `preserve` | `"smart"` | `--comment-attachment <choice>` | Choose how comments are attached to the syntax around them. |
| `commentIgnorePattern` | string | `""` | `--comment-ignore-pattern <string>` | Copy through untouched any comment whose text matches this regular expression. |
| `commentSpacing` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--comment-spacing <choice>` | Choose the spacing between a line comment marker and its text. |
| `commentWrap` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--comment-wrap <choice>` | Choose whether comment text is reflowed. |
| `commentWrapWidth` | int (0–1000) | `0` | `--comment-wrap-width <int>` | Wrap comment text at this column, or 0 to use the print width. |
| `footerComment` | string | `""` | `--footer-comment <string>` | Ensure the file ends with this comment text, inserting it when it is missing. |
| `jsdocAlign` | boolean | `false` | `--jsdoc-align` | Align the type, name and description columns of a documentation block's tags. |
| `jsdocBlankLineAfterDescription` | boolean | `false` | `--jsdoc-blank-line-after-description` | Separate a documentation block's description from its first tag with a blank line. |
| `jsdocDescriptionIndent` | int (0–24) | `0` | `--jsdoc-description-indent <int>` | Indent the wrapped continuation of a tag description by this many extra columns. |
| `jsdocNormalizeTags` | boolean | `false` | `--jsdoc-normalize-tags` | Rewrite documentation tag aliases to their canonical spelling, turning @return into @returns. |
| `jsdocTagOrder` | array | `[]` | `--jsdoc-tag-order <array>` | List documentation tags in the order they should be printed, with unlisted tags keeping their relative order at the end. |
| `jsdocWrap` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--jsdoc-wrap <choice>` | Choose whether documentation block descriptions are reflowed. |
| `preserveBannerComment` | boolean | `true` | `--no-preserve-banner-comment` | Keep the leading comment block of a file flush with the top and free of reflowing, so licence headers survive. |

## Blank Lines

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blankLineAfterDirectives` | boolean | `false` | `--blank-line-after-directives` | Print a blank line after the directive prologue of a file or function. |
| `blankLineAfterImports` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-after-imports <choice>` | Choose whether a blank line follows the import block. |
| `blankLineBeforeControlFlow` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-before-control-flow <choice>` | Choose whether if, for, while and switch statements are preceded by a blank line. |
| `blankLineBeforeExport` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-before-export <choice>` | Choose whether an export declaration is preceded by a blank line. |
| `blankLineBeforeReturn` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-before-return <choice>` | Choose whether a return statement is preceded by a blank line. |
| `blankLineBetweenMethods` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-between-methods <choice>` | Choose whether class members are separated by a blank line. |
| `blankLineBetweenTopLevel` | `preserve` · `always` · `never` | `"preserve"` | `--blank-line-between-top-level <choice>` | Choose whether top-level declarations are separated by a blank line. |
| `collapseEmptyBlockBlankLines` | boolean | `true` | `--no-collapse-empty-block-blank-lines` | Remove the blank lines from a block that contains nothing else. |
| `maxBlankLines` | int (0–8) | `1` <br>`2` for python | `--max-blank-lines <int>` | Collapse any run of blank lines to at most this many. |
| `maxBlankLinesAtEnd` | int (0–8) | `0` | `--max-blank-lines-at-end <int>` | Allow at most this many blank lines at the very end of a file. |
| `maxBlankLinesAtStart` | int (0–8) | `0` | `--max-blank-lines-at-start <int>` | Allow at most this many blank lines at the very top of a file. |
| `maxBlankLinesInsideBlocks` | int (0–8) | `1` | `--max-blank-lines-inside-blocks <int>` | Collapse any run of blank lines inside a block or function body to at most this many. |
| `padBlocks` | boolean | `false` | `--pad-blocks` | Print a blank line just inside the braces of every block. |
| `padClassBody` | boolean | `false` | `--pad-class-body` | Print a blank line just inside the opening and closing braces of a class body. |
| `padFunctionBody` | boolean | `false` | `--pad-function-body` | Print a blank line just inside the opening and closing braces of a function body. |

## Safety

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatMinified` | boolean | `false` | `--format-minified` | Format files that look minified, instead of leaving them alone. |
| `maxFileSizeKb` | int (0–1048576) | `4096` | `--max-file-size-kb <int>` | Refuse to format a file larger than this many kilobytes, or 0 to lift the limit. |
| `parseTimeoutMs` | int (0–600000) | `5000` | `--parse-timeout-ms <int>` | Abandon a parse that has run for this many milliseconds, or 0 to wait indefinitely. |
| `safetyCommentPreservation` | boolean | `true` | `--no-safety-comment-preservation` | Require every comment body in the input to appear in the output. |
| `safetyIdempotency` | boolean | `false` | `--safety-idempotency` | Format the output a second time and require the two results to be identical. |
| `safetyIdempotencyPasses` | int (1–8) | `1` | `--safety-idempotency-passes <int>` | Run this many extra formatting passes when the idempotency check is on. |
| `safetyNumericLiterals` | boolean | `true` | `--no-safety-numeric-literals` | Require every numeric literal to keep its value through any rewriting of its spelling. |
| `safetyOnFailure` | `preserve` · `warn` · `throw` | `"preserve"` | `--safety-on-failure <choice>` | Choose what happens when a safety check fails. |
| `safetyReparse` | boolean | `true` | `--no-safety-reparse` | Re-parse the output with the same parser and require it to succeed. |
| `safetyStringLiterals` | boolean | `true` | `--no-safety-string-literals` | Require the multiset of string and template literal contents to be identical before and after. |
| `safetyTokenCheck` | boolean | `true` | `--no-safety-token-check` | Re-lex the output and require the significant token stream to match the input exactly. |
| `safetyTokenCheckComments` | boolean | `true` | `--no-safety-token-check-comments` | Include comment tokens in the token comparison. |

## Experimental

| Option | Type | Default | CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `experimentalCommentReflow` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-comment-reflow` | **Experimental.** Reflow comment prose with the Markdown paragraph engine, preserving lists and code spans. |
| `experimentalDiffMinimization` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-diff-minimization` | **Experimental.** Prefer the layout closest to the input whenever two layouts are equally valid. |
| `experimentalIncrementalCache` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-incremental-cache` | **Experimental.** Reuse printed fragments for subtrees whose text has not changed since the previous run. |
| `experimentalJsxTextFill` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-jsx-text-fill` | **Experimental.** Fill JSX text as prose so that words repack rather than each child taking a line. |
| `experimentalMarkdownTableWrap` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-markdown-table-wrap` | **Experimental.** Wrap the contents of an over-wide Markdown table cell instead of letting the row overflow. |
| `experimentalOperatorPosition` | `end` · `start` | `"end"` | `--experimental-operator-position <choice>` | **Experimental.** Choose which side of a line break a binary operator lands on. |
| `experimentalPreserveSemanticBlocks` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-preserve-semantic-blocks` | **Experimental.** Treat a blank-line separated run of statements as a paragraph and keep it intact when breaking. |
| `experimentalTernaries` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-ternaries` | **Experimental.** Use the indented case-and-result layout for nested conditional expressions. |
| `experimentalWidthAwareChains` | boolean | `false` | `--experimental-width-aware-chains` | **Experimental.** Choose member chain layout by measuring every candidate rather than by counting links. |
